answer: The problem has been solved! I disabled the 'Use only one instance when started from file manager' option in VLC's preferences (Tools > Preferences > Interface Settings > Playlist and Instances section). After saving this setting, you can now launch multiple independent VLC instances that can play videos simultaneously. To open additional instances, right-click the VLC icon in your dock and select 'New Window'. You'll notice two VLC cone icons in the top bar when multiple instances are running.
